rca_of_the_issue.issue: Infinite redirect loop when navigating directly to /client-engagement/events or /client-engagement/crm-outreach
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In ClientEngagementPage.js, when an unknown path like 'events' is accessed under /client-engagement/*, the fallback Route path='*' redirects to 'calendar'. However, with the Route path='calendar/*' definition, this may cause recursive matching. The calendar component may also be re-rendering and triggering additional navigation.
reproduction_steps: 4. Console shows 'Maximum update depth exceeded' errors
rca_of_the_issue.potential_fix: 1. Add explicit redirect from /client-engagement/events to /client-engagement/proposals. 2. Review the 'calendar/*' and 'calendar' routes - one may be redundant. 3. Check EngagementCalendar for any navigation side effects in useEffect
